title: Corpus Record
description: A corpus record produced by enumerateLocal/collapseDuplicates/remoteOnly for a discovered repository, either local or remote-only. Not a card -- see schemas/card.schema.json for the searchable-index artifact built from this record.

path.description: Absolute path to the repository directory, null for remote-only repos

origin.description: Whether the repo has a local clone (local) or exists only on GitHub (remote)

remote.description: The remote URL (git@host:path or https://host/path format), null if no remote is configured

provenance.description: Ownership classification: 'own' if owned by the developer, 'foreign' if not

provenanceKnown.description: Whether provenance was verified locally (true for local repos with history, false for remote-only repos)

remoteReadFailed.description: Whether reading the remote URL from git config failed (local repos only)

head.description: Short commit hash local repos are currently at, null for a repo with zero commits or a remote-only record. collapseDuplicates compares this across siblings to detect divergence.

lastCommit.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the most recent commit, null for a repo with zero commits or a remote-only record

canonical.description: Whether this record won dedup as the canonical copy among clones sharing a remote. Added by collapseDuplicates; absent on raw enumerateLocal/remoteOnly records that were never deduped.

siblings.description: Names of other local clones collapsed into this one (empty if none). Added by collapseDuplicates.

diverged.description: Whether the canonical winner and at least one sibling clone are at different heads. Added by collapseDuplicates.

dedupVerified.description: Whether duplicate collapse was actually verified against a resolvable remote key rather than assumed. Added by collapseDuplicates.
